metadata.problem_statement: The function greet(name) in hello.py returns a misspelled greeting. For example, greet('World') currently returns 'Helo, World!' (one 'l' missing). Fix greet() in hello.py so it returns 'Hello, <name>!'. Do not change the function name or signature, and do not modify test_hello.py. Verify your fix by running: python test_hello.py
metadata.pre_commands:
mkdir -p /workspace/repo && cd /workspace/repo && git init -q . && git config user.email agent@local && git config user.name agent && printf '__pycache__/
*.pyc
' > .gitignore && cat > hello.py <<'PYEOF'
def greet(name):
    """Return a greeting for the given name."""
    return f"Helo, {name}!"
PYEOF
